title: Sprint Orchestra Conductor Cheatsheet and Ask Roster
content:
Purpose: put a lightweight, run-of-show cheat sheet and decision/ask roster in one page for Bridge Week / Sprint Orchestra and the immediate all-hands that follows. This is intentionally terse — designed to help a single conductor run the week, escalate fast, and get decisions into execs' hands by D+2.

Context: company-wide alignment week is a condensed 6-day cadence: 3 days of focused team sprints (workshops, demos, unblock cycles), 1 day of leadership reconciliation, 1 day of cross-team demos and readiness, and final all-hands. We need a small set of concrete asks and a clear critical path for decisions.

Quick commitments (what this doc expects from leads)
- Prepare 3 slide demo (2 min + 1 Q) that shows hypothesis, metric delta, and ask.
- Bring 1 risk and 1 mitigation for any cross-team dependency.
- Identify preferred decision (A/B/hold) and required approver.

Conductor roles (single-page roles — assign before week)
- Conductor (Priya): run run-of-show, triage asks, escalate to Exec Liaison.
- Scheduling Lead (Ethan): owns calendar slots, room/VC logistics, and demo timing.
- Ops Triage (Lina): owns fast risk log and connects to SRE/Infra SMEs.
- Exec Liaison (Samir): pre-briefs execs and circulates decision packets.
- Notetaker (rotating): captures action items and decision rationale in the shared note.

Run-of-show (compressed)
- Day -2 (prep): Conductor walkthrough with leads (30m); finalize asks roster.
- Day 0 (kick): Team workshops, unblock sessions, demo dry-runs.
- Day 1 (sync): Cross-team dependency windows, initial canaries, risk triage at 3pm.
- Day 2 (reconcile): Leadership decisions window 10am-12pm; finalize fallback policies.
- Day 3 (demo day): Public cross-team demos (afternoon), readiness checklist; finalize all-hands slides.
- Day 4 (all-hands): Exec updates, ask stack, publish decisions & action owners.

Decision packet template (what to include for each ask)
- Title (1 line)
- Owner (name + pager)
- Short ask (1 sentence)
- Why now (2–3 bullets: customer impact, cost/latency, compliance)
- Options considered (A/B/C) and recommended choice
- Impact on OKRs (which objective and expected delta)
- Required approver and deadline
- Risk & mitigation (2 bullets)
- Rollback/fallback plan (1 line)

Ask roster (initial — fill by Day -2)
- 1) Dedicated capacity scaling policy tweak
  owner: Lina Gomez  | approver: VP Infra (expected decision: A: enable burst seats)
  quick note: tight latency SLOs on search feature; cost delta forecast attached.

- 2) Hosted API pricing pilot for mid-market bundle
  owner: Marcus Lee  | approver: CFO (expected decision: B: pilot with 5 customers)
  quick note: revenue upside + telemetry plan required.

- 3) Private deployment on new cloud region (EMEA)
  owner: Ana Rodrigues  | approver: Head of Sales Ops (expected decision: A: greenlight infra spend)
  quick note: regulatory timeline and KMS route attached.

Critical path matrix (very small)
- Infra capacity (SRE signoff) -> required for demo fidelity -> blocks Hosted API pricing pilot metric.
- Legal compliance OK (security review) -> required for Private deploy request.
- Sales commitment (3 customers) -> required to greenlight pilot discount.

Fast escalation rules (if stuck)
- Triage at Ops Triage board 9am and 3pm; any unresolved ask moves to Exec Liaison packet by 4pm.
- Exec Liaison pre-briefs CEO/CTO at 5pm for decisions needing an exec ok overnight.

Measurement and artifacts to collect during the week
- Demo runbook artifacts: slides, short demo script, runbook link.
- One-pager decision packet for every ask (see template).
- Post-week quick survey to leads: 5 questions about clarity, blockers, and follow-through.

Communications (who sends what and when)
- Day -1: Conductor publishes final agenda + ask roster to #all-hands.
- Day 2 after leadership decisions: Exec Liaison publishes decision digest to execs + leads.
- Day 4 (all-hands): CEO closes with 3 top decisions + 30/60/90 owners.

Open questions / placeholders (to fill during Day -2 prep)
- Confirm CFO availability for pricing pilot decision (Samir to confirm).
- Get Infra cost delta estimate for burst seats (Ethan follow-up with SRE).
- Legal sign-off ETA for EMEA private deploy (Ana to loop in legal).

Notes to conductor (practical tips)
- Keep decision packets to one page max. Execs will not read >1 page per ask.
- Use the 2-minute demo rule strictly to keep the schedule moving.
- If a decision will change product behavior, require a short QA/monitoring checklist before rollout.

Post-week deliverables (D+2)
- Publish consolidated decision log (who decided what, rationale, action owners).
- Populate OKR tracker with any deltas and owners.
- 30/60/90 follow-up: schedule check-ins for leads with exec sponsors.

Appendix: quick templates and links (to be attached in final doc)
- Decision packet template (link/placeholder)
- Shared slides deck (link/placeholder)
- Risk log spreadsheet (link/placeholder)

End notes: this doc is a minimal conductor cheat sheet — iterative and intentionally informal. The goal: fewer long meetings, faster decisions, and clear owners. Fill roster by Day -2 and keep the conductor empowered to escalate.
